tasks.title: Define ContextAgentProtocol and AgentInput/AgentResult schemas
tasks.description: Create server/app/context_agent/protocol.py with ContextAgentProtocol (evaluate(AgentInput) -> AgentResult) and server/app/context_agent/schemas.py with all dataclasses: ConversationTurn, AgentInput, AgentResult, TokenUsage. The protocol must specify: must return within 5s, never raises on LLM failure, returns review_flag=True on failure. This blocks the triage A/B switch task.
acceptance_criteria: ContextAgentProtocol exists in server/app/context_agent/protocol.py
AgentInput frozen dataclass has all 7 fields including conversation_id and trace_id
AgentResult frozen dataclass has all 12 fields including A/B field frontline_prediction
TokenUsage frozen dataclass exists with input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_usd, model
isinstance(ContextAgent(...), ContextAgentProtocol) returns True

tasks.title: Define ContextAgentSettings pydantic-settings with all env vars including secrets
tasks.description: Create server/app/context_agent/config.py with ContextAgentSettings(BaseSettings). Must include all 13 env vars from the LLD: CONTEXT_AGENT_ENABLED, OPENAI_API_KEY (secret), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (secret), primary_llm, fallback_llm, timeout_s, max_history_turns, audit_db_path, slang_lexicon_path, daily_token_budget, daily_usd_budget, token_prices_path. Secrets must be validated as non-empty strings on startup when context_agent_enabled=True.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 env vars present with documented defaults
OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are marked as sensitive (no logging of values)
When CONTEXT_AGENT_ENABLED=True and OPENAI_API_KEY is empty, startup emits a WARNING (not error, for dev convenience)
daily_usd_budget default is 0.50 and daily_token_budget default is 100000

tasks.title: Wire structlog bound logger shomer.context_agent with required fields
tasks.description: Configure structlog.get_logger('shomer.context_agent') in server/app/context_agent/agent.py. Implement the three documented log events: context_agent_complete (happy path), context_agent_fallback (timeout/LLM error), context_agent_budget_exhausted. context_agent_complete must include: trace_id, model_used, is_real_threat, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, context_used, tools_called.
acceptance_criteria: context_agent_complete event includes all 9 required fields
context_agent_fallback includes: reason, timeout_s, model_attempted, fallback_applied, review_flag
context_agent_budget_exhausted includes: daily_usd_spent, daily_usd_budget, budget_reset_at
Token amounts are never logged at sensitive levels (no PII leak via message content)

tasks.title: Define and register Prometheus metrics for the context_agent module
tasks.description: Register all 8 context_agent metrics against shared REGISTRY: context_agent_requests_total (Counter, labels=[outcome]), context_agent_latency_seconds (Histogram), context_agent_threat_decision_total (Counter, labels=[decision]), context_agent_tokens_used_total (Counter, labels=[model, kind]), context_agent_usd_spent_total (Counter, labels=[model]), context_agent_budget_remaining_usd (Gauge), context_agent_tools_called_total (Counter, labels=[tool]), context_agent_error_total (Counter, labels=[error_type]). These metrics are the primary DFPR measurement infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 metrics registered against shared REGISTRY
context_agent_latency_seconds histogram has buckets covering 0.1s to 5s
context_agent_budget_remaining_usd Gauge is updated after every token usage record
context_agent_threat_decision_total{decision='not_threat'} increments when CA reverses a frontline offensive prediction

tasks.title: Define TokenManagerProtocol with Allowed/DeniedBudgetExhausted return types
tasks.description: Create the TokenManagerProtocol in server/app/context_agent/token_manager.py with before_call(model, estimated_input_tokens) -> BudgetDecision and after_call(model, actual_input, actual_output) -> None. Allowed frozen dataclass has estimated_cost_usd field

tasks.title: Implement token_prices.yaml price table and _estimate_cost() method
tasks.description: Create server/app/context_agent/token_prices.yaml with per-model per-kind prices for gpt-4o-mini (input $0.15/1M, output $0.60/1M) and claude-haiku-4-5 (input $1.00/1M, output $5.00/1M). tasks.title: Implement TokenManager SQLite schema and before_call/after_call logic
tasks.description: Implement TokenManager class implementing TokenManagerProtocol. Create _ensure_schema() for the token_usage table. Implement before_call() with asyncio.Lock that checks daily_token_budget and daily_usd_budget against today's SQLite totals. Implement after_call() with UPSERT into token_usage and Prometheus counter updates. Both methods are restart-safe via SQLite persistence.
acceptance_criteria: token_usage table created with UNIQUE(date_utc, model) constraint
before_call() with accumulated tokens near daily_token_budget returns DeniedBudgetExhausted
after_call() UPSERT increments existing row or inserts new row
asyncio.Lock prevents concurrent budget exhaustion race condition
After server restart, _daily_totals() reads accumulated usage from SQLite (not reset to zero)

tasks.title: Implement TokenManager budget-exhausted fallback in ContextAgent.evaluate()
tasks.description: Wire TokenManager.before_call() into ContextAgent.evaluate() so that DeniedBudgetExhausted causes _budget_exhausted_result() to return AgentResult(source='frontline_only', review_flag=True, budget_exhausted=True, model_used='none'). This prevents over-spending the daily LLM budget while preserving the safety invariant (never silently suppress an alert).
acceptance_criteria: _budget_exhausted_result() returns AgentResult with source='frontline_only' and review_flag=True
context_agent_budget_exhausted log event is emitted with daily_usd_spent and budget_reset_at
context_agent_requests_total{outcome='budget_exhausted'} increments
Budget exhaustion does NOT suppress the parent alert (is_real_threat follows frontline_label)

tasks.title: Implement TokenManager Prometheus metrics for token and cost tracking
tasks.description: Add the three TokenManager-specific Prometheus metrics to the shared REGISTRY: context_agent_tokens_used_total (Counter, labels=[model, kind={input,output}]), context_agent_usd_spent_total (Counter, labels=[model]), context_agent_budget_remaining_usd (Gauge). Wire these into after_call() so every LLM invocation updates all three metrics atomically with the SQLite write.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 token manager metrics registered against shared REGISTRY
context_agent_tokens_used_total{model='gpt-4o-mini', kind='input'} increments by actual_input after each call
context_agent_budget_remaining_usd Gauge reflects daily_usd_budget minus today's total spend
Metrics are updated in the same asyncio.Lock block as the SQLite UPSERT

tasks.title: Implement ToolRunner with read_conversation_history, lookup_slang, check_age_appropriateness
tasks.description: Implement server/app/context_agent/tools.py with ToolRunner class. read_conversation_history() queries audit.db for the last N turns for a conversation_id using asyncio.to_thread. lookup_slang() loads slang_lexicon.json once at init and does an in-memory lookup. check_age_appropriateness() returns a static dict from a hardcoded age-sensitivity table. All tools are local-only with no LLM cost.
acceptance_criteria: read_conversation_history('conv_abc', n=5) returns list of ConversationTurn (up to 5)
lookup_slang('לוזר מטומטם') returns {matches: [{word: 'לוזר', ...}, {word: 'מטומטם', ...}]}
check_age_appropriateness(13) returns {sensitivity_level: 'moderate', notes: '...'}
Missing slang_lexicon.json at ToolRunner init raises FileNotFoundError (fail-fast)
read_conversation_history uses asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop

tasks.title: Implement LlmRouter with GPT-4o-mini primary and Haiku 4.5 fallback
tasks.description: Implement server/app/context_agent/llm_router.py with LlmRouter class. Primary: call openai.AsyncOpenAI chat.completions.create with model='gpt-4o-mini', response_format={'type': 'json_object'}, temperature=0.1, max_tokens=512. On any exception: fall back to anthropic.AsyncAnthropic messages.create with model='claude-haiku-4-5'. Extract TokenUsage from response.usage. If both fail, re-raise the exception.
acceptance_criteria: LlmRouter.reason() returns (raw_text: str, model_used: str, TokenUsage)
Primary GPT-4o-mini failure triggers Haiku 4.5 fallback with warning log
TokenUsage.model is 'gpt-4o-mini' when primary succeeds, 'haiku-4.5' when fallback used
Both LLMs failing re-raises the last exception (caught by ContextAgent._fallback_result)
Temperature=0.1 is set to reduce LLM output variability on classification reasoning

tasks.title: Implement ContextAgent main class wiring all sub-components with 5s timeout
tasks.description: Implement server/app/context_agent/agent.py with ContextAgent class. Orchestrate: tool calls -> budget check -> asyncio.wait_for(llm_router.reason(), timeout=5.0) -> parse output -> after_call() token recording -> return AgentResult. Implement _fallback_result() (timeout/LLM error -> review_flag=True) and _budget_exhausted_result(). Record AgentResult to audit.db agent_traces table via asyncio.to_thread.
acceptance_criteria: ContextAgent implements ContextAgentProtocol
evaluate() completes within 5.1s even when mocked LLM takes 4.9s
asyncio.TimeoutError -> _fallback_result() with review_flag=True and source='frontline_only'
AgentResult includes frontline_prediction from AgentInput.frontline_label (A/B measurement)
agent_traces table row inserted after every evaluate() call

tasks.title: Implement context agent failure modes and safety invariant enforcement
tasks.description: Ensure all LLD §8 failure modes are covered: GPT-4o-mini error -> Haiku fallback; both LLMs fail -> review_flag=True; 5s timeout -> review_flag=True; malformed JSON -> parse safe default (is_real_threat=True); budget exhausted -> frontline_only+review_flag; audit.db locked -> retry once then skip write; slang_lexicon missing -> fail-fast at boot. Safety invariant: the CA NEVER silently suppresses an alert.
acceptance_criteria: Both LLMs mocked to fail -> AgentResult(source='frontline_only', review_flag=True)
asyncio.wait_for timeout -> AgentResult(review_flag=True) returned in < 5.5s
Malformed LLM JSON -> parse_agent_response returns is_real_threat=True (fail-safe)
audit.db write failure -> request succeeds (write is non-blocking, error is logged)
Safety invariant verified: no code path can return is_real_threat=False when an exception occurred
